data.name: Flame Jet
data.description: Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 3; Burn 0 You shoot a burst of flame behind you as a standard action, propelling you up to 60 feet in a straight line, including into the air; any movement upward costs double. If you end your turn mid-air, you fall on your next turn unless you use flame jet again.
